sentences.en: The last magic adventure had gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 这最后的魔法冒险有去了错误的。

sentences.en: Floppy had been left behind.
sentences.zh: Floppy 有是离开在……后面。

sentences.en: A giant bird had flown off with him.
sentences.zh: 一个巨人鸟有飞离开和……一起他。

sentences.en: This was because a horrid genie had escaped from a bottle.
sentences.zh: 这个是因为一个极讨厌的精灵有逃跑从一个瓶子。

sentences.en: "And it was all my fault," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 和它是全部我的缺点， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "We've got to rescue Floppy," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我们会有到解救 Floppy。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "We must go back into the adventure."
sentences.zh: 我们必须去回来进入这冒险。

sentences.en: "But we can't make the key glow," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 但是我们不能做这钥匙光亮， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "I know," Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 不！ 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "But we must try.
sentences.zh: 我知道， 说 Chip， 但是我们必须尝试。

sentences.en: We have to find a way to get the genie back in the bottle."
sentences.zh: 我们有到找到一个方式到得到这精灵回来在……里这瓶子。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip looked at the magic key.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 看在这魔法钥匙。

sentences.en: "Oh, if only it would glow," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 哦， 如果只有它会光亮， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Then the magic key did begin to glow.
sentences.zh: 然后这魔法钥匙做开始到光亮。

sentences.en: The magic took the children back into the last adventure.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿这孩子们回来进入这最后的冒险。

sentences.en: The magic took them to an island.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿他们到一个岛屿。

sentences.en: Biff had been there before.
sentences.zh: Biff 有是那里在……之前。

sentences.en: It was the island where the giant bird had flown away with Floppy.
sentences.zh: 它是这岛屿哪里这巨人鸟有飞离开和……一起 Floppy。

sentences.en: Kumar was still there.
sentences.zh: Kamar 是仍然那里。

sentences.en: He was with his father, Hassan.
sentences.zh: 他是和……一起他的爸爸， Hassan。

sentences.en: Hassan and Kamar were mending their boat.
sentences.zh: Hassan 和 Kamar 是门丁他们的船。

sentences.en: Kumar ran to meet them.
sentences.zh: Kamar 跑到遇见他们。

sentences.en: "You have come back!"
sentences.zh: 你有来回来！ 他说到 Biff。

sentences.en: He said to Biff.
sentences.zh: 咳！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "Where have you been?"
sentences.zh: 哪里有你是？

sentences.en: "You wouldn't believe it," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我不相信它！ 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "Even if we told you."
sentences.zh: 竟然如果它是冷的。

sentences.en: "This is my brother, Chip," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 这个是我的弟弟， Chip， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "We have come back to rescue Floppy."
sentences.zh: 我们有来回来到解救 Floppy。

sentences.en: Kumar shook his head.
sentences.zh: Kamar shook 他的头。

sentences.en: "That will be very dangerous," he said.
sentences.zh: 那个将是非常危险的， 他说。

sentences.en: He said.
sentences.zh: Biff， 他说。

sentences.en: "The giant bird took him up to the top of that mountain." "I know," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 这巨人鸟拿他向上到这顶的那个山。 不！ 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "And that's where we're going.
sentences.zh: 我知道， 说 Biff， 和那是哪里我们是去。

sentences.en: We must get up there as fast as we can." "Stop!" Shouted Kumar.
sentences.zh: 我们必须得到向上那里像快的像我们能。 停！ 喊 Kamar。

sentences.en: "Don't go!
sentences.zh: 不去！

sentences.en: Have you forgotten about the evil genie?"
sentences.zh: 有你忘记关于这邪恶的精灵？

sentences.en: "We'll worry about him later," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我们会担心关于他后来， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip went as fast as they could, but it was hard work.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 去像快的像他们能， 但是它是困难的工作。

sentences.en: They had to climb over big rocks.
sentences.zh: 他们有到爬在……上方大的岩石。

sentences.en: At last they came to the mountain.
sentences.zh: 在最后的他们来到这山。

sentences.en: Biff was tired.
sentences.zh: Biff 是累的。

sentences.en: She sat on a rock for a rest.
sentences.zh: 她坐在……上一个岩石为了一个休息。

sentences.en: "The mountain looks deep and rocky."
sentences.zh: 这山看陡峭的和岩石的。

sentences.en: "How can we climb up?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 如何能我们爬向上？ 问 Biff。 为什么？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: Then Chip found a dried up stream.
sentences.zh: 然后 Chip 找到一个脱水的向上溪流。

sentences.en: "Come on," Called Chip.
sentences.zh: 来在……上！ 来在……上， 叫 Chip。

sentences.en: "This gully looks an easy way up."
sentences.zh: 这个冲沟看一个容易的方式向上。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip began to climb up the gully.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 开始到爬向上这冲沟。

sentences.en: Suddenly there was a loud noise and a terrible smell.
sentences.zh: 突然地那里是一个大声的噪音和一个可怕的气味。

sentences.en: It was the evil genie.
sentences.zh: 它是这邪恶的精灵。

sentences.en: He was standing at the top of the gully.
sentences.zh: 他是站在这顶的这冲沟。

sentences.en: "Ah, I can soon get rid of you," He shouted.
sentences.zh: 我能很快得到使摆脱的你， 他喊。

sentences.en: The genie clapped his hands.
sentences.zh: 这精灵鼓掌他的手。

sentences.en: Water began to gush down the gully.
sentences.zh: 水开始到涌出向下这冲沟。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip had no time to climb out.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 有不时间到爬出。

sentences.en: The water rushed towards them.
sentences.zh: 这水仓促的向他们。

sentences.en: "Gully Biff, climb on this rock and hang on," Shouted Chip.
sentences.zh: 爬在……上到这个岩石和夯在……上， 喊 Chip。 她展示它到 Chip。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip hung on to the rock.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 各党势均力敌的在……上到这岩石。

sentences.en: The water roared past them.
sentences.zh: 这水咆哮过他们。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip were frightened.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 是受惊的。

sentences.en: "What are we going to do?" Shouted Biff.
sentences.zh: 什么是我们去到做？ 喊 Biff。 如何？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: "I don't know," called Chip.
sentences.zh: 我不知道， 叫 Chip。 来在……上， 叫 Chip。

sentences.en: "It's too far to jump to safety."
sentences.zh: 它是也远到跳到安全。

sentences.en: Then they saw Kamar.
sentences.zh: 然后他们看见 Kamar。

sentences.en: He had followed them to the mountain.
sentences.zh: 他有跟随他们到这山。

sentences.en: "Hang on!" He shouted.
sentences.zh: 哦不！ 哈！ 他喊。

sentences.en: "I'll soon have you safe."
sentences.zh: T'll 很快有你安全的。

sentences.en: He threw a rope across the gully.
sentences.zh: 他扔一个绳索穿过这冲沟。

sentences.en: It caught on a branch on the other side.
sentences.zh: 它抓住在……上一个树枝在……上这其他私德。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip climbed to safety on the rope.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 爬到安全在……上这绳索。

sentences.en: "We are so pleased to see you!" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我们是所以请到看见你！ 说 Biff。 哇！

sentences.en: "I thought we'd never get off that rock."
sentences.zh: 我想 we'd 从不得到离开那个岩石这邪恶的精灵做这个， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "The evil genie did this," Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 这邪恶的精灵出现！ 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "It's a good job I came when I did," said Kamar.
sentences.zh: 我来当……时我做， 说 Kamar。 帮助！ 叫 Kamar。

sentences.en: "I came to help you rescue Floppy."
sentences.zh: 我来到帮助你解救 Floppy。

sentences.en: They began to climb the mountain again.
sentences.zh: 他们开始到爬这山再一次。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip were pleased that Kamar had come to help them.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 是请那个 Kamar 有来到帮助他们。

sentences.en: The giant bird was flying high above them.
sentences.zh: 这巨人鸟是飞高的在他们。

sentences.en: "What have you done with Floppy?" Yelled Biff crossly.
sentences.zh: 什么有你做完和……一起 Floppy？ Biff 生气地。

sentences.en: It took them a long time to get to the top of the mountain.
sentences.zh: 它拿他们一个长的时间到得到到这顶的这山。

sentences.en: At last they reached the nest of the giant bird.
sentences.zh: 在最后的他们到达这窝的这巨人鸟。

sentences.en: "Ugh!" Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Look at all these bones.
sentences.zh: 看在全部这些骨头。

sentences.en: I hope the bird hasn't eaten Floppy!" "Floppy!" Called Biff.
sentences.zh: 我希望这鸟没有吃 Floppy！ 哦 Floppy！ Floppy！ 叫 Biff。

sentences.en: "Where are you?"
sentences.zh: 哪里有你是？

sentences.en: Then they saw Floppy.
sentences.zh: 然后他们看见 Floppy。

sentences.en: He was fast asleep and he had a contented look on his face.
sentences.zh: 他是快的睡着的和他有一个满足的看在……上他的脸。

sentences.en: In front of him was a pile of bones.
sentences.zh: 在……里前面的他是一个堆的骨头。

sentences.en: "Oh Floppy!" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 哦 Floppy！ 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "Wake up!"
sentences.zh: 醒来向上！

sentences.en: Floppy woke up and wagged his tail. Said Kamar.
sentences.zh: Floppy 醒来向上和摇摆他的尾。 帮助！ 叫 Kamar。

sentences.en: "I'm glad we're going," "We must get back quickly," said Kamar.
sentences.zh: 它意思是我们是去到是烂醉的。

sentences.en: "The evil genie may use his powers again." Thought Floppy.
sentences.zh: 这邪恶的精灵梅使用他的控制力再一次。 我憎恶船！ 想 Floppy。

sentences.en: "But I'm sorry I can't take all the lovely bones."
sentences.zh: Floppy， 但是我是对不起我不能拿全部这美丽的骨头。

sentences.en: They went down the mountain as fast as they could.
sentences.zh: 他们去向下这山像快的像他们能。

sentences.en: Then they saw Hasan.
sentences.zh: 然后他们看见 Hassan。

sentences.en: He had come to look for them.
sentences.zh: 他有来到看为了他们。

sentences.en: "I am so glad I have found you," he said.
sentences.zh: 我是所以高兴的我有找到你， 他说。

sentences.en: "I have been worried about you."
sentences.zh: 他是也发愁的关于这洪水。

sentences.en: "We are all safe," Said Kamar.
sentences.zh: 这相机是安全的。 帮助！ 叫 Kamar。

sentences.en: "And we have rescued Floppy." Hasan was worried.
sentences.zh: 我们没有解救 Floppy。 Hassan 是发愁的。

sentences.en: He looked at Kamar.
sentences.zh: 他看在 Kamar。

sentences.en: "The genie may use his powers again.
sentences.zh: 这精灵梅使用他的控制力再一次。

sentences.en: We must get away from the island as quickly as we can," he said.
sentences.zh: 我们必须得到离开从这岛屿像快速地像我们能， 他说。

sentences.en: They began to load things into the boat.
sentences.zh: 他们开始到装载东西进入这船。

sentences.en: Chip looked at the old chest on the beach.
sentences.zh: Chip 看在这旧的胸膛在……上这海滩。

sentences.en: It had been washed up in a storm.
sentences.zh: 它有是洗向上在……里一个暴风雨。

sentences.en: "I don't know what's inside it," said Hassan.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是什么里面它， 说 Hassan。 是， 说 Hassan。

sentences.en: "It could be treasure."
sentences.zh: 它能是宝藏。

sentences.en: "Why don't you open it?" Asked Chip.
sentences.zh: 为什么不你打开它？ 问 Chip。 Gran！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "I don't have a key," said Hassan.
sentences.zh: 我不有一个钥匙， 说 Hassan。

sentences.en: Said Hasan.
sentences.zh: 是， 说 Hassan。

sentences.en: Chip had an idea.
sentences.zh: Chip 有一个主意。

sentences.en: "Lend me the magic key, Biff," he said.
sentences.zh: 这魔法钥匙光亮在……里这夜晚， 他说。

sentences.en: He put the key in the lock and turned it.
sentences.zh: 他放这钥匙在……里这锁和转动它。

sentences.en: The lid of the chest sprang open.
sentences.zh: 这盖子的这胸膛 sprang 打开。

sentences.en: Everyone looked in the chest, but it was completely empty.
sentences.zh: 每个人看在……里这胸膛， 但是它是彻底地空的。

sentences.en: Suddenly there was a crackling sound and a terrible smell of old burnt socks.
sentences.zh: 突然地那里是一个劈啪声声音和一个可怕的气味的旧的烧短袜。

sentences.en: The evil genie appeared!
sentences.zh: 这邪恶的精灵出现！

sentences.en: "Hah!" "Ha!" he shouted.
sentences.zh: 哈！ 他喊。

sentences.en: "You have escaped my powers too many times.
sentences.zh: 你有逃跑我的控制力也许多时间。

sentences.en: Now I will deal with you once and for all."
sentences.zh: 我将交易和……一起你一次和为了全部。

sentences.en: Chip thought of a way to trick the genie.
sentences.zh: Chip 想的一个方式到诡计这精灵。

sentences.en: Quickly he shut the lid of the chest.
sentences.zh: 快速地他关上这盖子的这胸膛。

sentences.en: "Why did you shut that chest?" Asked the genie.
sentences.zh: 为什么做你关上那个胸膛？ 问这精灵。 是它宝藏？ 问这精灵。

sentences.en: "What is inside it?"
sentences.zh: 我惊奇是什么在……里它。

sentences.en: "Er... it's something very valuable," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 什么是里面它？ 它是某物非常很值钱的， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Is it treasure?" Asked the genie.
sentences.zh: 它能是宝藏。 是它宝藏？ 问这精灵。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "It's a lot more valuable than treasure," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 它是一个许多更多很值钱的比宝藏， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: The genie looked in the chest.
sentences.zh: 这精灵看在……里这胸膛。

sentences.en: "There's nothing valuable in here," he shouted.
sentences.zh: 有没有什么很值钱的在……里这里， 他喊。

sentences.en: "Oh, but there is," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 哦， 但是那里是， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "You're just not looking hard enough."
sentences.zh: 你是刚刚不看困难的足够。

sentences.en: The genie bent inside the chest to look.
sentences.zh: 这精灵弯曲的里面这胸膛到看。

sentences.en: Suddenly Chip pushed the genie into the chest and slammed down the lid.
sentences.zh: 突然地 Chip 推这精灵进入这胸膛和砰的一声关上向下这盖子。

sentences.en: Then he locked it with the magic key.
sentences.zh: 然后他锁它和……一起这魔法钥匙。

sentences.en: "How dare you!" Shouted the genie.
sentences.zh: 如何激你！ 喊这精灵。 哦是我能， 喊这精灵。

sentences.en: "You will pay for this when I get out."
sentences.zh: 你将付钱为了这个当……时我得到出。

sentences.en: "But you can't get out," called Chip.
sentences.zh: 但是你不能得到出， 叫 Chip。 来在……上， 叫 Chip。 哦是我能， 喊这精灵。

sentences.en: "Oh yes I can," shouted the genie.
sentences.zh: 哦是我能， 喊这精灵。

sentences.en: "I can't get out of bottles, but it's easy to get out of a chest."
sentences.zh: 我不能得到出的瓶子， 但是它是容易的到得到出的一个胸膛。

sentences.en: "But you're locked in," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 但是你是锁在……里， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "We don't believe you can get out."
sentences.zh: 我们不相信你能得到出。

sentences.en: "I'll use my powers," said the genie.
sentences.zh: 我会使用我的控制力， 说这精灵。 帮助！ 哭这精灵。

sentences.en: The genie made himself thin and started to slip through the keyhole.
sentences.zh: 这精灵做他自己瘦的和开始到滑倒穿过这锁孔。

sentences.en: Chip held the bottle over the keyhole, and the genie slid into it.
sentences.zh: Chip 拿着这瓶子在……上方这锁孔。

sentences.en: "He fell for my trick," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 他落下为了我的诡计， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "I thought he would."
sentences.zh: 我想他会。

sentences.en: Hassan and Kamar shook Chip's hand.
sentences.zh: Hassan 和 Kamar shook Chip 手。

sentences.en: "That was brilliant, Chip!" Said Kamar.
sentences.zh: 那个是明亮的， Chip！ 说 Kamar。 帮助！ 叫 Kamar。

sentences.en: "The genie is safely in the bottle.
sentences.zh: 这精灵是平安地在……里这瓶子。

sentences.en: Now we can all go home."
sentences.zh: 现在我们能全部去家。

sentences.en: "I'm glad it was all right in the end," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我是高兴的它是全部正确的在……里这末尾， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "And I'm glad Floppy is safe."
sentences.zh: Floppy 是安全的。

sentences.en: The magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: It was time to go.
sentences.zh: 它是时间到去。

sentences.en: "I bet Floppy hated this adventure," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我赌 Floppy 帽子这个冒险， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Floppy looked at them both.
sentences.zh: Floppy 看在他们两个都。

sentences.en: "I don't know," He thought.
sentences.zh: 我不知道， 说 Biff。 我惊奇如果。。？ 她想。

sentences.en: "I quite enjoyed it, really."
sentences.zh: 我相当享受它， 真的。

sentences.en: The magic took them home.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿他们家。

sentences.en: Kipper ran into Biff's room.
sentences.zh: Kipper 跑进入 Biff 房间。

sentences.en: "Hooray!
You rescued Floppy!" He said.
sentences.zh: 你解救 Floppy！ 他说。

sentences.en: "What happened to the evil genie?"
sentences.zh: 什么发生到这邪恶的精灵？

sentences.en: "We put him back in the bottle," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我们放他回来在……里这瓶子， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: The children looked at the little chest.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们看在这小的胸膛。

sentences.en: "I'm glad the bottle didn't come back from the adventure," said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 我是高兴的这瓶子没有来回来从这冒险， 说 Kipper。 哦帮助， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: Biff tried to lift the lid of the chest, but it wouldn't open.
sentences.zh: Biff 经过考验的到拿起这盖子的这胸膛， 但是它不会打开。

sentences.en: "And now the key won't fit," she laughed.
sentences.zh: 和现在这钥匙不会健康的， 她笑。
